manifest.name: Wishlist sales for Steam
manifest.description: Pushes when games on your public Steam wishlist go on sale at or above the discount you choose. Unofficial; not made by or affiliated with Valve.
manifest.author: Ferry

settings.label: Steam profile
settings.help: Your SteamID64 (17 digits), your profile link, or your custom URL name. Your wishlist must be public: Steam privacy settings → Game details → Public.

settings.label: Store country
settings.help: Two-letter country code for prices and currency, like us, gb or de.
